packed_ternary_layout.padding_rule: Tail elements beyond K within the byte boundary are masked and must not contribute to accumulation

integer_accumulation.safety_bound_formula: max_abs_acc = K * max_abs(input) * max_abs(weight) + max_abs(bias) <= INT32_MAX
integer_accumulation.overflow_behavior: Mathematical proof guarantees no int32 overflow for canonical models. Models exceeding bound trigger int64_t contract.

tolerance_domain.rule: Bounding floating-point discrepancies if FP post-processing exists

endianness.supported_architectures: Universal (automatic byte-level decode on any host endian)

edge_static_profile.error_model: StatusCode::ArenaBudgetExceeded (101) - no C++ exceptions required in core runtime
